summary.zh-CN: 仅选择官方标为免费且当前可用的模型变体；一般以 :free 结尾。模型名单经常变化，请在扫描页查询，不把所有模型当免费。
summary.en: Choose currently available free variants, typically ending in :free. Discover current IDs in Scan; not every model is free.

limits.zh-CN: 免费请求有平台与上游限制；账号余额/购买历史可能影响可用额度，以当前账号页面为准。
limits.en: Platform and upstream limits apply. Account balance and purchase history may affect access; check your account.

summary.zh-CN: 官方提供 Free Plan。示例模型来自免费限额表，接入前仍需查询当前目录及账号权限。
summary.en: The official Free Plan lists these example models. Recheck the live catalog and account access before use.

limits.zh-CN: 按组织和模型限制 RPM、RPD、TPM 等，任一维度先用尽都会限流。账号控制台为准。
limits.en: Organization/model RPM, RPD and token limits all apply. The first exhausted limit blocks requests; check your console.

summary.zh-CN: 仅部分模型提供免费层；示例来自官方定价表。付费层、音视频/图片模型与附加工具可能采用不同定价。
summary.en: Only selected models offer a free tier. Examples come from official pricing; paid tiers, media models and extra tools differ.

limits.zh-CN: 额度、地区和账号资格以 AI Studio 为准。免费层数据使用政策与付费层可能不同。
limits.en: Limits, regions and eligibility depend on AI Studio. Free-tier data-use policies may differ from paid tiers.

summary.zh-CN: 限时试用，不是持续免费 API。官方当前说明：验证付款方式后赠送5美元，30天到期。不要把试用模型登记为永久免费。
summary.en: A limited trial, not a recurring free API. Current docs describe $5 after payment-method verification, expiring after 30 days.

limits.zh-CN: 需要验证付款方式；额度用完或到期后需要购买额度。此项作为免费政策变化提醒保留。
limits.en: A verified payment method is required. After credit expiry/exhaustion, purchased credits are needed. Kept as a policy-change notice.
